title: Suspend core external resource work for genuine async I/O
api_or_output: Suspend core external resource work for genuine async I/O

acceptance.description: Provide optional internal async resource mode and explicit suspend/resume boundary for external subsets, nested parameter/general entities, framing/refill/EOF cleanup using existing resolution session async APIs; no Task.Run, sync-over-async, whole-resource buffering, or spans retained across awaits.

Prove delayed async-only resolver/stream open/read/disposal, exact consumed input, sequential callback pause/no-replay, token rebinding/cancellation, aggregate quotas/cycles/locations, and exactly-once cleanup preserving primary exceptions.
Preserve sync M2 behavior; demonstrate bounded scratch and real allocation evidence with focused correctness checks and task validation at a known revision.

handoff.summary: Read-only source review identifies synchronous external subset/PE/general entity and cleanup sites; repair core continuation rather than prebuffer resources.
